qs.q: An investigator is analyzing frozen sections of adipose-rich tissue and needs to preserve and stain neutral lipids. Which stain must be utilized on these unfixed frozen sections?
qs.e: Oil Red O is used for neutral lipids and fats, specifically on frozen sections because routine paraffin processing dissolves fat. Haematoxylin and Eosin is the routine general stain for standard paraffin-embedded tissue.
